description_en: Reruns failed subtasks in a specified data validation batch, scoped by rerun type to avoid a full rerun
description_zh: 对指定校验批次中未通过的子任务发起重跑，按重跑类型限定范围，避免全量重跑
name: ExecDataCheckRunFailed

parameters.help_en: The batch ID returned by the ExecDataCheckSaveTask operation
parameters.name: batch_id

parameters.help_en:
The rerun type. Valid values:

0: Reruns only execution-failed subtasks.
1: Reruns execution-failed and validation-failed subtasks.
2: Reruns execution-failed and stopped subtasks.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 重跑类型：0-仅重跑失败 1-重跑失败+不通过（默认） 2-重跑失败+被终止
parameters.name: type

data.description_en: The ID of the new batch created for this rerun

errCode.description_en: The error code. An empty string is returned if the call is successful
errCode.description_zh: 错误码，调用成功时为空字符串

errMessage.description_en: The error message. An empty string is returned if the call is successful
errMessage.description_zh: 错误信息，调用成功时为空字符串

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查本次调用问题

success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:

true: The call is successful.
false: The call failed. Check errCode and errMessage to identify the cause
success.description_zh: 调用是否成功：true 表示成功，false 表示失败，失败时结合 errCode 与 errMessage 排查
